references.finding: A full-height surf photograph separates a narrow left introduction from a large right serif title; two small photographic details form a lower corner.
Pink margin and tall balcony image sit behind an offset white directory sheet. The directory is organized by circular section numerals.
Water-drop photograph occupies a large left field, with a quiet pink title field and a small lower photographic corner.
A wide coast photograph meets a white lower ledge and a pink inset label. This provides a genuine horizontal photograph absent from the former crop pool.
Two architecture photographs occupy different heights; text follows the gaps between them rather than an equal card grid.
Black-and-white wooden facade and strong serif typography establish a different material texture while retaining the same pink paper.
Lake and piano photographs straddle pink and white page fields, with a narrow explanatory margin.
A coastal wooden crate replaces the surfer in a tall closing image. Large serif closing words remain outside the photographic subject.

excluded: Design and Thank You lettering baked over photographs
limitations: Available sources are raster reference slides, not original high-resolution photography.
Reviewed source rectangles exclude all visible source copy; enlargement is capped at 2.5 times cropped pixels.

cover.designReason: The original three-field cover language is retained: slim introduction, full-height surf image and an oversized serif title on pink.

toc.designReason: A balcony photograph separates the pink title margin from an offset white sheet with two complete numbered chapter entries.

chapter.designReason: A large water-drop photograph and an oversized serif numeral introduce the first chapter; the full chapter name remains on the clear pink right field.

ending.designReason: A large coastal-crate plate anchors the lower left, while closing serif typography and a brief article sit in the upper-right pink field.

content.designReason: A narrow article margin leads to two large photographs crossing the pink-to-white background seam, following reference 7.

The first source section becomes the large display passage. A titled photograph occupies the upper right; the second section is a full-width lower footnote, so it is no longer a caption beneath the photograph.
A two-line masthead and a wide roof plate form one asymmetric header; a single full-width article occupies the white page below.

The vertical title remains on the pink left margin, while the right side reads as prose, a wide coast photograph, then the second prose section.
A full-width first section opens the page, followed by a large central masthead. The second section and piano photograph then share the lower field, producing a top-to-middle-to-bottom reading path.
The large left display headline and low note form a pink page, while the white right page reads from an upper architecture plate through prose to a lower piano detail.
A large true page folio anchors an upper note; a lower pink band pairs a substantial crate photograph with the second note. The title remains a small running masthead.
Two original sections receive intentionally different typographic weight: a small left note and lower headline balance a larger right-hand reading passage, without adding a decorative photograph.
